title: Retained foreground transcript and read-only tool Changes
purpose: Make terminal history compact, readable and stable under resize while preserving exact semantic evidence and existing execution behavior.

Stop and name required files before editing outside a row wall.

requirements.title: Terminal-independent identities and deterministic projection
requirements.spec: WHEN a typed live or committed record arrives, THE SYSTEM SHALL reduce it through norn::session_view using I1..I8, without terminal types, disk I/O, provider calls or a duplicate host reducer.
acceptance: Test same-name overlapping tools, item_id→call_id aliases, freeform calls, orphan results and duplicates across page boundaries.
Test retry within a multi-response turn, authoritative response_items versus flat projections, refusal, cancellation and provisional alias invalidation; never identify by text equality.

Explicit body allowlist and unknown custom-event classification exclude opaque/private provider replay state. Each current enum variant has a disposition fixture; future variants force exhaustive review.
No Ready/snapshot subscription API or durable generation claim is introduced.

Implement the six public core seams named in design.json.public_core_contracts. Cursor/body minting is crate-internal and source-owner validated; public consumers cannot construct arbitrary approved roots/fields.

Projection inputs/history items carry compact approved metadata and body references, never cloned raw SessionEvent/ResponseTranscriptItem payloads containing opaque/private state. Validate every provenance/correlation boundary and retain unknown origin explicitly.
Design provenance: I1-I8, D4, producer-coverage.json in ../design.json; producer obligations ../producer-coverage.json; PTY oracles ../acceptance.json.

requirements.title: Demanded history and approved body ranges
requirements.spec: WHEN the view requests history or a body, THE SYSTEM SHALL validate the source/cursor/reference/range and return only the requested data or an explicit typed failure, without holding store locks during filesystem work.
acceptance: Refuse wrong source/generation, mismatched EventId/ordinal, stale provisional revision, forged/traversing/outside-root spool references and unavailable/malformed bodies.
Real temporary spool tests prove requested byte ranges, UTF-8 chunk reconstruction, short reads and file failures; raw JSON-range reads do not claim decoded arbitrary field paging.
Store pages clone only selected records; render/resize have zero body/history reads. A user page/search/expand action requests explicit demand and exposes partial coverage.
No new committed push/append-family edits: later host owner must integrate ordinary, batch, idempotent and provider-identity-adoption paths separately. Do not emit a fake durable cursor.
Initialize distinct StoreInstanceId in all three EventStore constructors and validate every cursor against that instance/session binding. Empty-start is explicit.
Range reads use the owning SpoolWriter private data_dir/registered/root_session_id and PrivateRoot; no caller-supplied root path or exported arbitrary-path capability.
Design provenance: I6-I8, F1, F4, session-host-review STORE-COMMIT/BODY-RANGES in ../design.json; producer obligations ../producer-coverage.json; PTY oracles ../acceptance.json.

requirements.title: Migrate every transcript and status producer
requirements.spec: WHEN any current TUI producer emits user-visible content or current state, THE SYSTEM SHALL retain it semantically through one local projection adapter and preserve its origin and execution semantics.
acceptance: All entries in producer-coverage.json have executable assertions for semantic output/state, including child-result batches, steered/queued delivery, root inbound wake, MCP command completion/refusal, all step outcomes and startup/new/compaction notices.
Broadcast lag creates a visible incomplete state and boundary reconciliation without repeating tools or inventing missing transient events; forced lag case is a required fixture.

/new swaps store binding and view generation coherently with existing rotation dependencies; historical data and draft treatment follow D-F3/D-F5 controls. Resume loads demanded history with truthful older-coverage status.
Channels remain external framed content; no slash parsing or fabricated human sender. Child results retain actual child/source identity even where the old display used write_user_message.
All production writes leave semantic producers; only the later single frame/terminal owner writes terminal bytes. This row and R4 are an integration unit, not separately shippable UI.

ViewConfig owns the declared history/body/clipboard preferences from D-F4, with typed validation, visible effective values and explicit /view updates. R1/R2 contain no default demand sizes. Geometry defaults remain solely in render/layout.rs, avoiding duplicated constants.
Design provenance: D4-D5, I1-I8, producer-coverage.json in ../design.json; producer obligations ../producer-coverage.json; PTY oracles ../acceptance.json.

requirements.title: Own frame, layout, caret and styled content
requirements.spec: WHEN the app paints or receives geometry/input, THE SYSTEM SHALL compose one full-screen frame under the viewport invariants and restore terminal modes on every supported exit path.
acceptance: Alternate-screen entry/leave, bracketed paste, mouse/Kitty/synchronized output and cursor restoration are owned exactly once. No production DECSTBM scroll-growth/cursor-accounting API remains.

Retain semantic markdown/code/diff/structured formatting as styled rows; no ANSI capture/parser/terminal emulator is introduced. Renderer errors are handled visibly. No dependency addition in this wall.
Full-width composer, no global header/footer; narrow switch/restore, popup and focus follow the D-F2 geometry. Zero/tiny sizes preserve state without coordinate underflow or accidental submission.
Resize invalidates layout only; stable logical anchor/selection, draft, provider-call count and store-event count remain unchanged. Incoming live updates cannot steal focus.

Update crates/norn-tui/Cargo.toml package description from obsolete DECSTBM wording only; no dependency or manifest policy changes. R8 owns layout.rs/layout_tests.rs; integration consumes its public rectangles/geometry without editing those files concurrently.
Design provenance: D1, viewport_invariants, WS-01, WS-02, WS-16 in ../design.json; producer obligations ../producer-coverage.json; PTY oracles ../acceptance.json.

requirements.title: Compact known/unknown calls and honest per-call Changes
requirements.spec: WHEN a tool is shown, THE SYSTEM SHALL display compact description/status and allow historical expansion or a read-only exact call change view without touching provider context or workspace files.
acceptance: Every known and unknown tool starts compact; original description/call/status/duration stays visible, with missing fields explicitly unavailable. Individual historic expansion obeys D-F3 override rules.
Real edit/write/patch output shapes prove committed-with-diagnostic-error distinct from blocked/uncommitted; no action-log-success filter.
Opening an old link reads its recorded argument/result/spool references only, even after disk changes or deletion. Missing before-content cannot produce an empty-baseline diff.
Bash/MCP/unknown writer coverage remains explicitly unknown; no invented authorship or session-wide diff. Changes exposes no save/mutation handler.
Design provenance: D3, change_evidence_rules, I5-I6, WS-03, WS-05, WS-06 in ../design.json; producer obligations ../producer-coverage.json; PTY oracles ../acceptance.json.

requirements.title: Reading, selection/copy, search/export and existing controls
requirements.spec: WHEN a person navigates retained content, THE SYSTEM SHALL provide keyboard and mouse actions with explicit focus/capability/scope, while preserving current composer and runtime-control behavior.
acceptance: Selection binds original logical text/body revision across Unicode, wrapping, resize and paging. Copy strips UI/control bytes and never converts soft wraps into hard newlines; unavailable or unacknowledged clipboard is not reported as confirmed success.

Scoped search/export cover older history through explicit demand with partial/unavailable states; disk export targets an explicit operator path and reports errors/overwrite decisions without hidden persistence.

Built-in slash list derives from existing shared registry, plus selected skills/@file autocomplete. Popup selection precedes send/view keys; keyboard-only focus/expand/scroll/follow/search/copy/export/resize is discoverable.

Multiline paste never submits. Preserve Unicode editing/history, Enter/newline capability behavior, Escape popup/draft handling, Ctrl+C active cancellation/idle exit, Ctrl+T steer/queue, Ctrl+E reasoning/secondary fields, model/effort/tier and NCS settings validation, usage/status and MCP command-exit guards.
Existing child activity and result delivery remain visible. View selection does not grant new worker control or change message targets.

Register /view once in the shared built-in catalogue as TUI-only. Preserve exhaustive CLI enum handling without installing a CLI action or sending view commands to the model. Slash completion/help use this same entry.

The /view palette lists and invokes every view action and explicit settings: focus, pane visibility, split, browse, expand/reset overrides, follow/pin, selection, copy/export, search scope/load-more, history/body demand and clipboard capability. Mid-turn /view is intercepted locally before steer/queue admission; other input behavior is unchanged.

F6/Shift+F6 cycles visible regions; F2 toggles upper pane; PgUp/PgDn browse focus; non-composer Enter expands; F3 search, F4 copy, F5 export; arrows resize a focused divider. Existing composer/popup/cancellation actions have precedence. Unavailable function keys have the /view equivalent.
Design provenance: viewport_invariants, F2-F5, WS-11, WS-16, producer-coverage.json in ../design.json; producer obligations ../producer-coverage.json; PTY oracles ../acceptance.json.

requirements.title: Real PTY checkpoint and exact-commit evidence
requirements.spec: WHEN the integrated checkpoint is verified, THE SYSTEM SHALL exercise actual run_app in a real PTY with deterministic provider/tool/store fixtures and verify semantic invariants alongside terminal behavior before venue release checks.
acceptance: Execute PTY-01..PTY-09 in acceptance.json; use real PTY dimensions/events, barrier-controlled provider fixtures and real tool-result semantics. Missing prerequisites fail clearly; no silent skips, no provider credentials required.

Existing model/budget/prompt-history, channel wake/hold/next-turn and child/cancel tests retain their semantic assertions; replace old escape-sequence shape assertions with new owned-frame/restoration assertions.

Supported real terminal and multiplexer selection/copy/restoration require recorded manual evidence; PTY OSC52 bytes alone cannot prove actual clipboard acceptance. Capture old artifact if reproducible; otherwise label initial diagnosis source-supported, not runtime-reproduced.

Run strict fmt/all-target Clippy and declared battery legs on final exact commit at205, with source/gates/guard/venue witnesses and raw result references. Required rigorous review and source-transfer authorization are separate from a green battery. No local pass/fixture timing is a landing receipt or performance claim.
Design provenance: acceptance.json, D5, WS-01, WS-02, WS-03, WS-11, WS-16 in ../design.json; producer obligations ../producer-coverage.json; PTY oracles ../acceptance.json.

requirements.label: R4.layout
requirements.title: R4.layout — independent pure geometry foundation
requirements.spec: WHEN given terminal geometry, requested composer rows and explicit pane/split policy, THE SYSTEM SHALL calculate rectangles and a typed no-paint/resize-required/single/split result without session semantics, terminal I/O or mutable application state.
acceptance: Expose a pure LayoutRequest/LayoutPolicy to Layout result seam. Inputs include cols/rows, requested composer rows, Changes visibility, preferred split and active upper pane/focus. Results provide bounded composer/content/divider rectangles and effective mode; saved preferences are inputs, never rewritten when clamped. No imports from norn::session_view or app state.

Declare default equal upper-pane split, minimum content width40 each plus one divider, composer maximum12 rows and at most half terminal rows. Width81 is the derived split threshold. Explicit validated policy overrides win; no second copy of these defaults elsewhere.

Allocate odd split surplus deterministically to conversation, clamp actual split to both minima, and retain the original preference for widening. Changes closed gives conversation all upper width; narrow Changes-open uses the selected single upper pane.

Zero width or height returns no paint. Geometry unable to retain at least one composer row and one conversation/content row returns resize-required while preserving caller state. Otherwise requested composer height is clamped by declared policy; integration adds popup only if it fits after essential content.

Test widths80/81/82, height0/1/2, empty/oversized requested composer height, extreme u16 geometry, custom validated policy, open/closed/narrow pane selection, repeated shrink/widen with unchanged preferences and rectangle containment/non-overlap. Test numbers are geometry cases, not a performance SLA.
Root alone edits these two files. No render/mod.rs wiring in this row; R4 performs it after R3 and completed R8. Files have documented public APIs and mod.rs policy remains intact.
Design provenance: D-F2, declared_defaults, viewport_invariants in ../design.json; producer obligations ../producer-coverage.json; PTY oracles ../acceptance.json.
